g.title: KTX_QSP
g.text: Kidney Transplant Rejection & Immunosuppression — Quantitative Systems Pharmacology Map
donor antigen → allorecognition → T-cell and B-cell effector arms → TCMR / DSA / ABMR → nephron loss → graft failure,
held in balance against BK / CMV / malignancy by one manipulable quantity: net immunosuppression
20 mechanistic modules · 243 nodes · 385 edges · states carried as ODEs in ktx_mrgsolve_model.R are drawn with a double border

g.title: cluster_risk
g.text: 1. Donor / recipient risk set — everything that is fixed before the anastomosis

g.title: cluster_iri
g.text: 2. Ischaemia-reperfusion injury · innate priming · delayed graft function

g.title: cluster_allorec
g.text: 3. Allorecognition — how the recipient learns the graft is foreign

g.title: cluster_tact
g.text: 4. T-cell activation — signal 1 (TCR) · signal 2 (costimulation) · signal 3 (IL-2/mTOR) — where 5 drug classes act

g.title: cluster_tpop
g.text: 5. T-cell compartments · memory · the effector-to-regulatory balance

g.title: cluster_tcmr
g.text: 6. T cell-mediated rejection — the tubulointerstitial lesion

g.title: cluster_bcell
g.text: 7. B-cell arm — germinal centre · plasmablast · the long-lived plasma cell that no B-cell drug reaches

g.title: cluster_abmr
g.text: 8. ABMR effector arms — complement · FcgammaR/NK ADCC · direct endothelial signalling · 'missing self'

g.title: cluster_cnipk
g.text: 9. Calcineurin-inhibitor PK — the exposure that has to be steered

g.title: cluster_bio
g.text: 11. Biologics — induction, costimulation blockade, and the ABMR toolbox

g.title: cluster_nis
g.text: 12. NET IMMUNOSUPPRESSION — the single quantity that trades rejection against infection

g.title: cluster_adh
g.text: 13. Adherence and exposure variability — the commonest modifiable cause of late graft loss

g.title: cluster_func
g.text: 14. Graft structure and function — nephron mass, haemodynamics, filtration

g.title: cluster_fib
g.text: 15. Chronic injury — IFTA, the final common pathway (drug-independent)

g.title: cluster_bk
g.text: 16. BK polyomavirus — the price of the other arm of the U

g.title: cluster_inf
g.text: 17. CMV, other infection and malignancy — the rest of the over-immunosuppression arm

g.title: cluster_dx
g.text: 18. Diagnostic and decision layer — what the clinician can actually see
